_doc: Defaults for every character; maps/<character>.json overrides any key (deep merge). Units: rig units unless noted.

gaze._doc: yaw0/pitch0 = median world gaze of Seamless train canon (rad): the avatar's median look = at the camera

face._doc: calibrated on Seamless train canon percentiles: smile p50 0.19 p95 0.92 -> 0.11 / 1.0; browInnerUp p95 0.58; eyeBlink p50 0.19 (looking down droops the lid: corr -0.78 with gaze pitch); jawOpen p95 0.27

hands._doc: wrist offset from the population rest (arm lengths, chest frame; x outward) -> contract hand space; anchored on REST/CHIN/WAVE_UP/HAND_ON_HEART/POINT_SIDE/POINT_CAMERA

baseline._doc: causal slow baseline removal (per session): v - weight * EMA_tau(v); removes a person's sustained posture / gaze bias, keeps the moves
